c74object.name: el.granola~
c74object.description:
el.granola~ is a real-time granular pitch shifter that transposes audio using three overlapping, Hann-windowed grain streams reading from an internal circular delay line. Transposition is controlled by a playback increment ratio (where 1.0 is original pitch, 2.0 is an octave up, and 0.5 is an octave down). The increment can be adjusted via control messages or modulated continuously at audio rate.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Audio signal to be pitch-shifted, and control message inlet (clear, size, mute).
Inlet 2 [Right Inlet] (signal / float): Transposition increment ratio (1.0 = unison, 2.0 = octave up, 0.5 = octave down).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Pitch-shifted audio output signal.

inlet.description: Incoming audio signal to be pitch shifted, as well as control messages (clear, size, mute).
Playback speed and pitch shift multiplier. Accepts float numbers or audio-rate signals.

outlet.description: The composite granular output of the three overlapping grain voices.

objarg.name: grain-size
objarg.description: Required. Initial grain duration in milliseconds. Larger values improve low-frequency pitch resolution but introduce more latency. Note that the size message cannot resize grains larger than the size allocated at instantiation.

method.name: clear
method.description: Zeroes out the internal circular delay buffer.

method.name: float
method.description: Sets the playback speed/pitch ratio (must be greater than 0.0).

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to float and sets the transposition increment ratio.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), normal granular pitch shifting resumes.

method.name: size
method.description: Dynamically adjusts the active grain size in milliseconds and recalculates the window envelope. The new size cannot exceed the initial size allocated when the object was instantiated.

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 is the audio to be pitch shifted. Signal arriving at inlet 2 continuously modulates the transposition increment at audio rate.
